Messages.Author: Cartman
Messages.Body:
I looked through Google searching for clarification on Blood of the Cobra,
but I'm still a little confused:

how does it exactly work?
Does Thetmes deal agg. ranged damage?
How do Scorpion's Touch and Dagon's Call work with BotC?

Many thanx

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Cartman wrote:
>
> I looked through Google searching for clarification on Blood of the Cobra,
> but I'm still a little confused:
>
> how does it exactly work?

Inferior: you strike for 1R damage.
Superior: You play a non-ranged strike that requires Quietus from your
hand and use that strike as if it were ranged (if the chosen strike is
a hand strike, the hand strike's damage is not ranged and this strike
is not a hand strike).

> Does Thetmes deal agg. ranged damage?

No. Only his hand damage is aggravated.

> How do Scorpion's Touch and Dagon's Call work with BotC?

The hand and/or melee weapon strike enabled by ST and DC do not
become ranged.

Not complaining here, just noting that currently the only non-ranged
Quietus strikes that aren't ST or DC are the (weak) Vascular Explosion and
the (lame) Weakness. Hopefully Anarchs or some other set will include
